pattern: SELECT .+ FROM Courses AS C LEFT JOIN Sections AS S ON C\.course\_id = S\.course\_id WHERE S\.section\_id IS NULL OR COUNT\(S\.section\_id\) < 2
correction: Replace the query with: SELECT T1.course_name , T1.course_id FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Sections AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_id HAVING count(*) <= 2

metadata.description: This rule corrects a query that uses an inappropriate left join and filtering condition for finding courses with fewer than 2 sections.
